source: Alright… Better make sure I didn’t forget anything…
translation: 好了……最好再确认一下有没有忘带什么……

source: Come in.
translation: 请进。

source: Good morning, Sir Goro!
translation: 早上好，Goro先生！

source: Y-You look dashing, sir. Are you going somewhere today?
translation: 先、先生今天看起来真精神。您要去什么地方吗？

source: Ah, yes, I am. I have a meeting scheduled with Mr. Clermont.
translation: 啊，是的。我和Clermont先生约好要开个会。

source: Oh. What’s on the agenda, if I may ask?
translation: 哦。方便的话，我能问问会议内容吗？

source: It’s just the usual weekly meeting to discuss the progress of the sponsorship. I figured it wasn’t worth mentioning.
translation: 只是照常开的周会，讨论赞助事项的进展。我觉得没什么特别值得一提的。

source: Hehe, you do tend to be private with your work, sir.
translation: 呵呵，先生在工作方面确实总是很低调。

source: Though, I’m a bit curious – aren’t you a little nervous to be meeting him today?
translation: 不过我有点好奇——今天要见他，您一点都不紧张吗？

source: No, not at all. Why would you ask that?
translation: 不，完全不紧张。你为什么这么问？

source: W-Well, the last time Mr. Clermont was here, you acted quite differently from your usual self. I mean… I’ve never seen you that frantic before.
translation: 这、这个嘛，上次Clermont先生来的时候，您和平时很不一样。我是说……我从没见过您那么慌乱。

source: Hey, I was calm the whole time I was showing him around… I made sure not to show my excitement until after he left.
translation: 喂，我带他参观时一直都很镇定……直到他离开以后，我才显露出兴奋的样子。

source: After all, Mr. Clermont is someone I’ve looked up to for a long time. I didn’t think I’d ever meet him in person, so his visit really caught me off guard.
translation: 毕竟Clermont先生是我仰慕已久的人。我从没想过能亲自见到他，所以他来访时，我确实有些措手不及。

source: His works really inspired me to do some self-reflection in the past.
translation: 过去，他的著作确实启发我进行过许多自我反思。

source: R-Right…
translation: 是、是啊……

source: Anyway, what brings you to the office, Yoshinori?
translation: 话说回来，Yoshinori，你来办公室有什么事？

source: Oh… Actually, I was planning to ask for my weekly task list, but it can wait since you’re busy!
translation: 哦……其实我是来领取本周任务清单的，不过您既然在忙，晚点再说也没关系！

source: I can just do maintenance tasks around the camp and keep things in tip-top shape.
translation: 我可以先在营地里做些维护工作，把各处都打理妥当。

source: Actually, Yoshinori…
translation: 其实，Yoshinori……

source: Why don’t you come with me today?
translation: 今天不如和我一起去吧？

source: Really, sir? I don’t want to get in your way, especially in an important meeting.
translation: 真的吗，先生？我不想妨碍您，尤其这还是一场重要会议。

source: Nonsense. Sooner or later, you’re going to have to be attending these anyway.
translation: 胡说。反正你迟早也得参加这种会议。

source: You will need a formal outfit, however. I have a spare suit here that you can use. It’s older, but it should fit you.
translation: 不过你需要一套正装。我这里有套备用西装可以给你穿，虽然有些年头了，但应该合身。

source: We’ll leave as soon as you get changed.
translation: 你换好衣服，我们马上出发。

source: Y-Yes, sir!
translation: 是、是，先生！

source: {i}(I don’t know why, but even though we’re only going out for a business errand… I’m really excited to be with Sir Goro today.){/i}
translation: {i}（不知道为什么，明明只是一起外出办事……今天能和Goro先生同行，我却非常兴奋。）{/i}

source: {i}(It’s almost like those old scouting trips we used to take.){/i}
translation: {i}（简直就像以前那些童军旅行一样。）{/i}

source: {i}(It's rare that Sir Goro and I are on the road together like this, but we've hardly talked since we headed out this morning…){/i}
translation: {i}（我很少像这样和Goro先生一起出行，可从早上出发到现在，我们几乎都没说过话……）{/i}

source: {i}(I should probably say something to break the ice…){/i}
translation: {i}（我或许该说点什么打破沉默……）{/i}

source: {i}(I should probably say something to break the ice…){/i}{fast}
translation: {i}（我或许该说点什么打破沉默……）{/i}{fast}

source: Stay quiet.
translation: 保持安静。

source: {i}(I really don't want it to seem like I'm not taking this errand seriously, so maybe I should just stay quiet.){/i}
translation: {i}（我不想让人觉得自己没认真对待这次差事，也许还是安静一点比较好。）{/i}

source: *ahem* So, Yoshinori.
translation: *清嗓子* 那么，Yoshinori。

source: Oh! Yes, sir?
translation: 哦！怎么了，先生？

source: I can’t help but notice the brooch you attached to your suit.
translation: 我注意到你在西装上别了一枚胸针。

source: Talk about the weather.
translation: 聊聊天气。

source: Th-The weather’s really nice today, isn’t it, sir…?
translation: 今、今天天气真不错，对吧，先生……？

source: Yeah, it is.
translation: 嗯，确实。

source: {i}(Well, that went nowhere… ){/i}
translation: {i}（好吧，完全没聊起来……）{/i}

source: Talk about the meeting.
translation: 聊聊会议。

source: Th-Thank you again for letting me tag along today, sir…!
translation: 再、再次感谢您今天让我同行，先生……！

source: I’m not sure how exactly I can help, but I’m glad you’re letting me see what you’ve been working on with Mr. Clermont these past few weeks.
translation: 我还不知道自己具体能帮上什么忙，不过您愿意让我了解这几周和Clermont先生共同推进的工作，我真的很高兴。

source: I'm glad you're excited for this. I can tell by how much you've been fidgeting with your suit this whole time.
translation: 你这么期待，我很高兴。看你一路上不停摆弄西装，我就知道了。

source: Aah…! I didn’t realize I was doing that…!
translation: 啊……！我都没意识到自己一直在弄……！

source: Although… I can’t help but notice the brooch you attached to it.
translation: 不过……我倒是注意到了你别在上面的胸针。

source: Talk about the suit.
translation: 聊聊西装。

source: Th-Thanks again for lending me your suit, sir…! It’s been so long since I’ve worn something this formal!
translation: 再、再次谢谢您把西装借给我，先生……！我已经很久没穿过这么正式的衣服了！

source: Ah, hopefully the fit isn’t too loose on you.
translation: 啊，希望穿在你身上不会太宽松。

source: Not at all, sir! It’s actually perfect for this season’s weather too!
translation: 完全不会，先生！而且正适合现在这个季节的天气！

source: That’s good. I knew that style and color would suit you well...
translation: 那就好。我就知道这种款式和颜色很适合你……

source: Wasn’t that the one I gave you back when you were a scout?
translation: 那不是你还是童军时，我送给你的那枚吗？

source: Yes, it is, sir…!
translation: 是的，先生……！

source: I haven’t seen that in years. I’m surprised you still have it.
translation: 我已经很多年没见过它了。没想到你还留着。

source: Of course, it meant a lot to me, so I kept it safe.
translation: 当然，它对我意义重大，所以我一直好好保存着。

source: I thought it might be a bit of a good luck charm for today!
translation: 我想今天把它当作幸运符也不错！

source: Hahaha, and you thought I was the one being nervous earlier.
translation: 哈哈哈，你刚才还以为紧张的人是我呢。

source: Ah… Hehehe…
translation: 啊……嘿嘿嘿……

source: You know, Yuri was quite jealous when I gave you that brooch.
translation: 你知道吗，当年我把那枚胸针送给你时，Yuri可是相当嫉妒。

source: She even accused me of picking favorites among the campers.
translation: 她甚至指责我在营员中偏心。

source: It couldn’t be helped though… You were quite the showoff when you were a scout.
translation: 不过这也没办法……你当童军时可是相当爱出风头。

source: R-Really? I hardly remember how I was back then…
translation: 真、真的吗？我都不太记得自己当时是什么样了……

source: Not much has changed, if I do say so myself… You’re still that go-getting, active scout that I remember.
translation: 要我说，其实没怎么变……你依然是我记忆里那个积极进取、活力十足的童军。

source: You really stood out amongst your peers, especially on that first camping trip we had.
translation: 你在同龄人中一直很出众，尤其是我们第一次露营旅行的时候。

source: In fact, that was when I gave you that brooch.
translation: 事实上，我就是在那次旅行中把胸针送给你的。

source: Yeah, I remember…
translation: 嗯，我记得……

source: Listen up, scouts! We’ll be heading out on a hike to the fields in just a few moments!
translation: 听好了，童军们！我们马上就要出发，徒步前往原野！

source: I want everyone to find their assigned partner and double-check both of your gear.
translation: 所有人找到自己分配到的搭档，并再次检查双方的装备。

source: That’s all for now! We’ll be leaving in five minutes!
translation: 暂时就这些！五分钟后出发！

source: Ughhhh… five more minutes? Can’t we go already? It’s been two hours since we woke up!
translation: 呃啊啊……还要五分钟？我们就不能现在出发吗？起床都已经两个小时了！

source: Come on, Yuri. We used most of that time to get dressed and have our breakfast.
translation: 别这样，Yuri。那段时间大多都用来穿衣服和吃早餐了。

source: More importantly, you know how much all these checks matter.
translation: 更重要的是，你知道这些检查有多重要。

source: But you already checked our stuff, like, three times this morning!
translation: 可你今天早上已经检查我们的东西差不多三遍了！

source: And if I hadn’t, I wouldn’t have found out that you packed nothing but your notebooks.
translation: 要不是我检查了，还发现不了你除了笔记本什么都没装。

source: They’re called fanfics, hmph!
translation: 那叫同人小说，哼！

source: And that’s why I paired Yoshinori with you, dear. Hahaha.
translation: 所以我才把Yoshinori安排成你的搭档，宝贝。哈哈哈。

source: It’s only a one-night trip, so how much stuff could we need?
translation: 不过只住一晚而已，能需要多少东西？

source: Well, if you’d been paying attention to our lessons, you would know to bring the basics, such as your navigation tools, adequate food and water, a first-aid kit, and more!
translation: 这个嘛，如果你上课时认真听讲，就该知道要带齐基本物品，例如导航工具、充足的食物和饮水、急救包等等！

source: We packed extra clothing, bug spray, and toiletries too, sir!
translation: 我们还带了备用衣物、驱虫喷雾和洗漱用品，先生！

source: See? Yoshinori here clearly took notes!
translation: 看见了吗？Yoshinori显然认真做了笔记！

source: Well, your five minutes are up and we’re all ready, so let’s goooooo!
translation: 好啦，五分钟已经到了，大家也都准备好了，快出发吧——！

source: Alright, alright, I’ll get everyone started.
translation: 好吧，好吧，我这就带大家出发。

source: Okay, scouts! Form up into a line and find your buddies! We’re going to begin our march.
translation: 好了，童军们！排成一列，找到自己的搭档！我们要开始行进了。

source: Follow me!
translation: 跟我来！

source: How’s everyone holding up?
translation: 大家还撑得住吗？

source: This path I chose for our first camping trip is a short and safe one to help everyone familiarize themselves with the trail for our future hikes!
translation: 第一次露营旅行，我特意选择了一条既短又安全的路线，好让大家熟悉今后徒步会经过的小径！

source: Just make sure to stay close to your buddy and keep following my lead, alright scouts?
translation: 一定要和搭档待在一起，继续跟紧我，明白了吗，童军们？

source: Now, some of you might be wondering why I’ve assigned you all in pairs. The reason for this is to improve your sense of cooperation, especially in times of emergency!
translation: 有些人可能想知道，我为什么要把你们两两分组。这是为了培养大家的合作意识，特别是在遇到紧急情况时！

source: If your team gets separated, it’s important to stay calm and find a solution with your partner!
translation: 如果你们的小队与大家走散，务必保持冷静，和搭档一起想办法解决！

source: You have access to your navigation tools to help get you both back on track, reach the destination, or return to camp.
translation: 你们可以利用导航工具找回正确路线、抵达目的地，或者返回营地。

source: In case you truly get lost, do not panic, remember to conserve your energy, and stay in place.
translation: 万一真的迷路，不要惊慌，记得保存体力并留在原地。

source: You can make use of your survival items, such as your flint, flashlight and sleeping bag, to set up a temporary camp.
translation: 你们可以使用打火石、手电筒和睡袋等生存用品，搭建临时营地。

source: Creating a fire is especially helpful, as the smoke could help rescue teams locate you faster.
translation: 生火尤其有用，因为烟雾能帮助救援队更快找到你们。

source: With all of these survival tools and knowledge from the lessons we’ve had, you’ll definitely be able to handle an emergency!
translation: 有了这些生存工具，再加上课堂中学到的知识，你们一定能应对紧急情况！

source: Kyaa! I can’t believe we’re finally doing something exciting!
translation: 呀！真不敢相信，我们终于要做点刺激的事了！

source: Staying in the campgrounds all day long was starting to bore me!
translation: 整天待在营地里，我都快无聊死了！

source: Don’t say that, Yuri! I’m sure Sir Goro had a good reason to keep us in the camp, and he did his best to make everything interesting there!
translation: 别这么说，Yuri！Goro先生让我们留在营地肯定有充分的理由，而且他也尽力让那里的每项活动都变得有趣！

source: Yeah, yeah, I know! But did we really HAVE to wait for two weeks to actually start camping at a summer camp?
translation: 好啦好啦，我知道！可我们参加的明明是夏令营，真的有必要等整整两周才正式开始露营吗？

source: I’m sure trips like these needed a lot of planning and preparation to make sure everything goes perfectly!
translation: 这种旅行肯定需要大量规划和准备，才能确保一切顺利！

source: Besides, isn’t it great we get to learn all this cool, new stuff from Sir Goro?
translation: 而且，我们能从Goro先生那里学到这么多新奇又有趣的知识，不是很好吗？

source: *sigh* I already know all of this…
translation: *叹气* 这些我早就知道了……

source: *ahem* Not everyone had a head start like you, dear.
translation: *清嗓子* 不是每个人都像你一样提前学过这些，宝贝。

source: A-Ah, Sir Goro…!
translation: 啊、啊，Goro先生……！

source: Yuri here has been interested in nature for a long time, so most of the things I’ve been teaching here are things she already knows.
translation: Yuri很早就对大自然产生了兴趣，所以我在这里教的大部分内容，她都已经知道。

source: Yeah! Dad bought me a lot of books about camping and survival!
translation: 没错！爸爸给我买了很多关于露营和野外生存的书！

source: The actual experience is always different though! Just like you, most of your fellow scouts have never even tried camping or exploring the great outdoors.
translation: 不过亲身体验总是不一样的！和你一样，大多数童军伙伴从未真正露营过，也没有探索过广阔的户外世界。

source: It’s my duty as a scoutmaster to prepare everyone for a trip like this through the exercises and lessons we’ve done so far.
translation: 通过此前的训练和课程，让大家为这样的旅行做好准备，是我作为童军团长的职责。

source: Everything I taught you all will guarantee that everyone has a fun and safe time today!
translation: 我教给你们的一切，会确保大家今天既安全又玩得开心！

source: I guess you have a point…
translation: 好吧，你说得也有道理……

source: Now be more patient, dear.  Use this opportunity to share the knowledge you’ve learned!
translation: 耐心一点，宝贝。利用这个机会把你学到的知识分享给大家！

source: But it sounds like Yoshi knows everything already too.
translation: 可是听起来，Yoshi好像也什么都知道了。

source: O-Oh! I only learned it all from Sir Goro’s lessons…!
translation: 哦、哦！这些都是我从Goro先生的课程中学到的……！

source: We’re really lucky to have you teaching and guiding us, sir!
translation: 能得到您的教导和指引，我们真的很幸运，先生！

source: Hehehe… Look at you, sucking up to my dad like that~
translation: 嘿嘿嘿……瞧你这样讨好我爸爸～

source: W-Wah…! I-I’m just telling the truth!
translation: 哇、哇……！我、我只是在说实话！

source: All the activities Sir Goro made for us back at camp were great preparations for today, especially the group ones!
translation: Goro先生在营地为我们安排的所有活动，尤其是集体活动，都为今天做了很好的准备！

source: We all got to know each other a lot better through them, and we learned how to work together!
translation: 通过那些活动，我们更加了解彼此，也学会了怎样合作！

source: You should be more enthusiastic like Yoshinori here, dear. It seems he got the point of the lessons exactly right!
translation: 宝贝，你应该像Yoshinori这样积极一点。他看来完全领会了这些课程的重点！

source: Now, shall we resume our hike? We’re almost at our destination!
translation: 好了，我们继续徒步吧？已经快到目的地了！

source: O-Oh...! On second thought, I need to take this call.
translation: 哦、哦……！等等，我得先接这个电话。

source: Attention, scouts! We’ll be taking a short break!
translation: 童军们注意！我们短暂休息一下！

source: Make sure to use this time to have some snacks and hydrate.
translation: 利用这段时间吃点零食、补充水分。

source: I’ll be right back!
translation: 我马上回来！

source: *sigh* Not again… Just when I thought everything was going well today.
translation: *叹气* 怎么又来了……我还以为今天一切都很顺利。

source: H-Huh? What do you mean, Yuri?
translation: 咦、咦？你是什么意思，Yuri？

source: I really don’t want to talk about it. There’s nothing we can do about it anyways.
translation: 我真的不想谈这件事。反正我们也无能为力。

source: A-Are you sure? Maybe there’s something we can do to help Sir G—
translation: 你、你确定吗？说不定我们能做些什么来帮Goro先——

source: *pinches Yoshinori*
translation: *掐了一下Yoshinori*

source: O-Ow! Wh-What was that for, Yuri??
translation: 好、好疼！你、你为什么掐我，Yuri？？

source: I told you it’s no use! Let’s just stay out of it!
translation: 我都说了没用！我们别插手这件事！

source: You didn’t have to pinch me so hard…
translation: 你也不用掐得这么用力吧……

source: Come on, let’s just distribute some snacks and water to everyone while we wait!
translation: 走吧，趁着等待，我们给大家分些零食和水！

source: Oh… alright.
translation: 哦……好吧。

source: …What do you mean you can’t come? It’s okay if you’re going to be late, we don’t mind waiting.
translation: ……你说不能来是什么意思？晚一点没关系，我们不介意等你。

source: How can you not have time?! You know I’ve been planning this activity for weeks, and—
translation: 你怎么会没时间？！你明知道我为这次活动准备了好几个星期，而且——

source: Yuri’s been looking forward to today! Can’t you understand how important this is?
translation: Yuri一直期待着今天！你难道不明白这有多重要吗？

source: You’re never around, Vera! This is the only time I asked you to be together as a family!
translation: 你总是不在身边，Vera！这是我唯一一次请求你和我们全家待在一起！

source: What are you even busy with?!
translation: 你到底在忙些什么？！

source: N-No, I’m not trying to accuse you of anything!
translation: 不、不是，我并没有想指责你什么！

source: I know having a family was never our plan, but it’s been nineteen years!
translation: 我知道组建家庭从来不在我们的计划之中，可已经十九年了！

source: Just please come over, at least for Yuri…
translation: 求你过来吧，至少为了Yuri……

source: H-Hello?
translation: 喂、喂？

source: A-Ah! Yoshinori…!
translation: 啊、啊！Yoshinori……！

source: Uhh… Sir? Is everything alright…?
translation: 呃……先生？一切都还好吗……？

source: Y-Yes. It’s just a personal matter, nothing for you to worry about.
translation: 没、没事。只是些私事，你不用担心。

source: What brings you here though?
translation: 不过，你来这里有什么事？

source: What brings you here though? {fast}
translation: 不过，你来这里有什么事？{fast}

source: When are we starting our hike again?
translation: 我们什么时候继续徒步？

source: I just wanted to ask when we'd start our hike again, sir!
translation: 我只是想问问我们什么时候继续徒步，先生！

source: I see. I apologize for the short delay. Let me come back right away.
translation: 我明白了。抱歉耽搁了一会儿，我马上回去。

source: W-Well… I also came to ask you about something I thought I could help you with, sir…!
translation: 这、这个……我也想问问有没有什么能帮上您的，先生……！

source: Oh, what is it?
translation: 哦，什么事？

source: I'm here to report.
translation: 我是来报告情况的。

source: I’m here to make a report, sir…!
translation: 我是来向您报告情况的，先生……！

source: Hm? Is everything alright back there?
translation: 嗯？后面一切都还好吗？

source: Y-Yes, sir! In fact, Yuri and I handed out some drinks and snacks to the other scouts while we were waiting…!
translation: 是、是的，先生！事实上，等待的时候，我和Yuri给其他童军分发了饮料和零食……！

source: Ah, good job, Yoshinori. Let me come back right away and resume our hike.
translation: 啊，干得好，Yoshinori。我马上回去，继续带大家徒步。

source: I wanted to check on you.
translation: 我想来看看您。

source: I-I wanted to check on you, sir…!
translation: 我、我想来看看您，先生……！

source: Yuri and I were handing out some drinks and snacks to the other scouts while we were waiting.
translation: 等待的时候，我和Yuri一直在给其他童军分发饮料和零食。

source: And I thought a drink might help you relax some too, so I came looking for you as soon as we finished…!
translation: 我想喝点东西或许也能让您放松一些，所以一忙完就过来找您了……！

source: Thank you for your concern, Yoshinori. I’m fine.
translation: 谢谢你的关心，Yoshinori。我没事。

source: I-I’m sorry for prying, but… if there’s anything I can do, please let me help you, sir…
translation: 很、很抱歉多问，但是……如果有什么我能做的，请让我帮您吧，先生……

source: I noticed you seemed a little upset.
translation: 我注意到您似乎有些难过。

source: I noticed you seemed a bit upset when you got the call… So, I thought you might need some company!
translation: 我注意到您接电话时似乎有些难过……所以想，也许您需要有人陪一陪！

source: You don’t have to worry about the other scouts too! Yuri and I just finished handing out drinks and snacks to them!
translation: 您也不用担心其他童军！我和Yuri刚给他们分完饮料和零食！

source: I-If it’s okay with you, I can actually lead the scouts for the rest of the hike! You don’t have to worry about any of us getting lost since I’ve got the map memorized!
translation: 如、如果您同意，接下来的路可以由我带领童军们！地图我已经全都记住了，您不用担心我们会迷路！

source: O-Oh, and we can set up the camp at the fields in advance, so we’ll have more time to do an outdoor activity for the rest of the day…!
translation: 哦、哦，还有，我们可以提前在原野上扎营，这样今天剩下的时间里就能多安排一项户外活动……！

source: I really appreciate your intentions, Yoshinori, but you don’t have to take over.
translation: 我很感谢你的好意，Yoshinori，但不需要由你完全接手。

source: B-But, sir…
translation: 可、可是，先生……

source: *sigh* I knew you weren’t going to give up that easily…
translation: *叹气* 我就知道你不会这么轻易放弃……

source: Why don’t we lead the scouts together, then?
translation: 那么，我们一起带领童军们怎么样？

source: I will let you take the front end of the march, and I will watch over your side to make sure everyone follows your lead. What do you think?
translation: 我让你走在队伍前面，而我从旁照看，确保所有人都跟着你的步伐。你觉得怎么样？

source: I’d be honored, sir! Thank you for letting me help!
translation: 这是我的荣幸，先生！谢谢您愿意让我帮忙！

source: I’ll gather everyone immediately…!
translation: 我马上召集大家……！

source: Ah, Yoshinori… One more thing.
translation: 啊，Yoshinori……还有一件事。

source: Y-Yes, sir…?
translation: 是、是，先生……？

source: I want you to have this…
translation: 我想把这个交给你……

source: It’s something I made way back when I was preparing for Camp Buddy’s launch.
translation: 这是我当年筹备 Camp Buddy 开营时制作的东西。

source: Oh, it’s the same symbol that’s around the camp and on our uniforms…!
translation: 哦，这和营地各处以及我们制服上的标志一样……！

source: Yes, the insignia represents the core meaning of this camp.
translation: 是的，这枚徽记代表着这座营地最核心的理念。

source: A star that always burns bright, no matter what; just like someone you can count on to help you through even the darkest times.
translation: 一颗无论发生什么都始终闪耀的星；就像一个值得信赖的人，即使身处最黑暗的时刻，也能帮助你渡过难关。

source: This may not mean much right now, but I assure you it will make sense one day.
translation: 现在它或许还没有太多意义，但我保证，总有一天你会明白。

source: Th-Thank you very much, sir! I’m really honored to have this…!
translation: 非、非常感谢您，先生！能拥有它，我真的深感荣幸……！

source: You’re welcome, Yoshinori. Now let’s get going. Everyone must’ve finished with their break.
translation: 不用谢，Yoshinori。现在出发吧，大家应该都休息好了。

source: N-Now I’m kinda embarrassed of how I acted back then… I didn’t realize how much of a showoff I was…
translation: 现、现在想起自己当时的表现，我都有点不好意思……没想到以前的我那么爱出风头……

source: Well, it’s not exactly a bad thing. I understood that you were just thrilled to be at the camp.
translation: 这倒也不完全是坏事。我知道你只是因为来到营地而格外兴奋。

source: I probably wouldn’t have given you that brooch if it weren’t for that quality of yours.
translation: 如果不是因为你身上的这种特质，我大概也不会把那枚胸针送给你。

source: A-Ah… I’m not sure if I should take that as a compliment, sir.
translation: 啊、啊……先生，我不知道该不该把这当成夸奖。

source: Hmm… Let’s just say I just saw something promising in you, from the way you acted, to the way you were willing to lead and take charge.
translation: 嗯……这么说吧，从你的表现，到你主动带头、承担责任的态度，我在你身上看到了潜力。

source: I wanted to give you some form of acknowledgement for it.
translation: 所以我想用某种方式认可你的表现。

source: Heh, and it turns out I was right too. Just look at how far you’ve come today.
translation: 呵，事实证明我也没有看错。看看如今的你已经走了多远。

source: Th-Thank you, sir. It really honors me to know that you place so much faith in me and my abilities.
translation: 谢、谢谢您，先生。得知您如此信任我和我的能力，我真的深感荣幸。

source: Although, I have to admit, every time you tell me that I’ll be next in line for your role at Camp Buddy, I always wonder if I can really do it.
translation: 不过我得承认，每当您说我会成为 Camp Buddy 的下一任负责人时，我总会怀疑自己是否真的做得到。

source: Come on, where’s that overflowing enthusiasm you had back then?
translation: 振作一点，你当年那股满溢的热情去哪儿了？

source: If I had told the younger Yoshinori that he was going to be in charge, he’d never have been able to calm down!
translation: 如果我告诉年少时的Yoshinori，将来会由他负责这里，他肯定会兴奋得根本平静不下来！

source: And besides, you’ve been leading this camp for many years now. While we had some setbacks, your performance the previous term was enough to prove that you have what it takes to carry the torch someday.
translation: 况且，这些年来你一直在带领这座营地。虽然我们遭遇过一些挫折，但你上个营期的表现已经足以证明，终有一天你有能力接过这份使命。

source: You flatter me too much, sir…
translation: 先生，您太抬举我了……

source: You know, the reason I gave you that badge is the same reason I brought you to this business meeting today.
translation: 你知道吗，我当初把徽章送给你的理由，也正是今天带你参加这场商务会议的理由。

source: As much as I’m your superior, I want us to lead Camp Buddy side by side, just like we did back then…
translation: 即使我是你的上级，我也希望我们能并肩带领 Camp Buddy，就像当年那样……

source: I know that your intentions are in the right place, and they go beyond just for the sake of the camp, exactly like what I saw in you that day.
translation: 我知道你的出发点是正确的，而且不只是为了营地本身，就和我那天在你身上看到的一模一样。

source: So, you better pay close attention to this meeting and learn something from it, or else I won’t let you come along next time!
translation: 所以你最好认真听会，从中学到些东西，否则下次我可不带你来了！

source: Yes, sir! I’ll do my best!
translation: 是，先生！我会尽全力！

source: {i}Sir Goro is trying his best to open up around me, reminiscing about the past and chatting casually.{/i}
translation: {i}Goro先生正努力在我面前敞开心扉，回忆往事，轻松地和我聊天。{/i}

source: {i}It’s really refreshing to be able to talk to him on such a personal level, and not just about work… {/i}
translation: {i}能像这样和他聊些私人的话题，而不只是谈工作，感觉真的很新鲜……{/i}

source: {i}I’ll make sure to show Sir Goro that he was right to place his trust in me!{/i}
translation: {i}我一定会向Goro先生证明，他对我的信任没有错！{/i}

source: W-Wow… So, this is where Mr. Clermont works…?
translation: 哇、哇……这里就是Clermont先生工作的地方吗……？

source: Yeah… Fancy, isn’t it? I was surprised too the first time I came here.
translation: 是啊……很气派，对吧？我第一次来时也很惊讶。

source: I still can’t believe that someone like Mr. Clermont really sponsored Camp Buddy…
translation: 我还是不敢相信，Clermont先生这样的人真的赞助了 Camp Buddy……

source: We really have to thank Mr. Nagame and his friends for that…
translation: 这件事确实得感谢Nagame先生和他的朋友们……

source: While Mr. Clermont was impressed by our camp, I think their story was really what convinced him to support us like this.
translation: 虽然我们的营地给Clermont先生留下了深刻印象，但我认为真正说服他这样支持我们的，是他们的故事。

source: Mr. Nomoru? Mr. Clermont would like to see you now!
translation: Nomoru先生？Clermont先生现在请您进去！

source: That’s our cue. Let’s go!
translation: 轮到我们了。走吧！

source: *gulp* Suddenly, I’m feeling nervous.
translation: *咽口水* 我突然开始紧张了。

source: It’ll be fine, Yoshinori. Just follow my lead.
translation: 不会有事的，Yoshinori。跟着我就好。

source: R-Right!
translation: 好、好的！

source: Good day, Mr. Clermont.
translation: 您好，Clermont先生。

source: Ahh! It’s been a while, Mr. Nomoru!
translation: 啊！好久不见，Nomoru先生！

source: I hope you don’t mind, but I brought my head scoutmaster with me today – this is Yoshinori Nagira.
translation: 希望您不会介意，我今天带了童军总团长一起来——这位是Yoshinori Nagira。

source: I apologize for not informing you beforehand.
translation: 没有提前通知您，实在抱歉。

source: No problem at all! I believe we met when I visited your camp the first time, didn’t we, Mr. Nagira?
translation: 完全没问题！我第一次参观贵营地时，我们应该见过，对吧，Nagira先生？

source: Yes, sir! It’s a pleasure to meet you again as well, Mr. Clermont!
translation: 是的，先生！我也很高兴再次见到您，Clermont先生！

source: And we’re right on time, so let’s get straight to business, shall we?
translation: 时间刚刚好，我们直接谈正事吧？

source: Yes, sir.
translation: 好的，先生。

source: So, I’ve got a bit of good news for you – as you may know, the little book “Greatest Memories” that we’ve published has been on the shelves and online stores for over a month.
translation: 我有个好消息要告诉两位——你们应该知道，我们出版的小书《最美好的回忆》已经在实体和线上商店发售一个多月了。

source: I’d like to congratulate you both, as it’s our most outstanding release yet! It generated a lot more sales than we anticipated!
translation: 我要恭喜二位，这是我们迄今表现最出色的出版物！销量远远超过了预期！

source: O-Oh, wow… That’s really amazing!
translation: 哦、哦，哇……这真是太棒了！

source: It seemed the public recognized the potential I saw from it and your camp. It was such a breath of fresh air from anything that’s out there in the market!
translation: 看来大众也认同我从这本书和贵营地中看到的潜力。与市面上的其他作品相比，它实在令人耳目一新！

source: And as they say, “strike while the iron is hot”; the good publicity we’re getting from the book is a great opportunity to divert into the camp itself!
translation: 俗话说“趁热打铁”；这本书带来的良好口碑，正是把关注引向营地本身的绝佳机会！

source: With the majority of the sales being allocated for upgrades around Camp Buddy, we’re able to offer a full sponsorship for many years to come!
translation: 把大部分销售收入投入 Camp Buddy 的升级后，我们将有能力在未来多年提供全面赞助！

source: Thank you so much again for seeing the worth of our camp, Mr. Clermont.
translation: 再次感谢您认可我们营地的价值，Clermont先生。

source: I believe this is more than just a business – it’s about what your place stands for in this generation!
translation: 我认为这不只是一门生意——更重要的是，贵营地对这一代人所代表的意义！

source: I’m glad we’re on the same page, sir!
translation: 很高兴我们的理念一致，先生！

source: Moving forward, let’s discuss our upgrade plans.
translation: 接下来，我们谈谈升级计划。

source: You are familiar with the Federation of Unified Camping Boy Scouts, or FUCBoyS, I believe?
translation: 我想你应该了解联合露营童军联合会，也就是 FUCBoyS 吧？

source: Yes, of course, we follow their guidelines for most of our camp activities.
translation: 当然，我们大多数营地活动都遵循他们的指导规范。

source: I have conducted a meeting with their association and asked for a business consultation on how to improve the camp.
translation: 我已经与该协会开过会，并请他们就如何改善营地提供商业咨询。

source: The insight from these professionals gave us a huge scope of potential upgrades with the budget that we have.
translation: 这些专业人士的见解，让我们看到在现有预算下可以进行大范围升级。

source: Of course, with the camp president’s approval and go signal.
translation: 当然，前提是营地负责人批准并同意启动。

source: Ah… May I ask what upgrades they specifically suggested?
translation: 啊……请问他们具体提出了哪些升级建议？

source: Well, we would be here all day if we discussed each and every bullet.
translation: 这个嘛，如果逐条讨论，恐怕一整天都说不完。

source: But to give you a preface, it’s mostly expansions to the camp!
translation: 不过概括来说，主要是扩建营地！

source: I was made aware that the annex area beside the camp was meant for upgrades. This was the biggest job that they suggested.
translation: 我了解到，营地旁边的附属区域原本就是为扩建预留的。这是他们建议中规模最大的工程。

source: The FUCBoyS Association figured that since we’re expecting more campers next term, they would like to build more cabins and facilities!
translation: FUCBoyS 协会认为，既然下个营期预计会有更多营员，就应该增建更多木屋和设施！

source: It’s something we’ve foreseen as well. In fact, we actually began refurbishing old, run-down cabins last summer in preparation for the next term.
translation: 这也是我们预见到的问题。事实上，去年夏天我们已经开始翻修老旧破败的木屋，为下个营期做准备。

source: That’s great! That should help us get a head start on the biggest chunk of the work.
translation: 太好了！这样我们就在最大的一部分工程上抢占了先机。

source: However, there are equally important suggestions on top of this, such as technology integration, gear upgrades and a new curriculum to establish safety interests.
translation: 除此之外，还有一些同样重要的建议，例如引入新技术、升级装备，以及制定强调安全意识的新课程。

source: Oh… This is beyond what I expected…
translation: 哦……这超出了我的预期……

source: I’ll email you the specifics on each topic so you can consider them thoroughly.
translation: 我会把每个项目的具体内容发到你的邮箱，供你仔细考虑。

source: Understood. I’ll make sure to review everything carefully.
translation: 明白。我一定会认真审阅所有内容。

source: I appreciate all the work you’ve put into sponsoring our camp, Mr. Clermont. I am extremely grateful.
translation: 感谢您为赞助营地付出的所有努力，Clermont先生。我真的万分感激。

source: Yes, we can’t thank you enough, Mr. Clermont!
translation: 是的，无论怎样感谢您都不为过，Clermont先生！

source: Like I said before, it’s my pleasure to be a part of your cause.
translation: 就像我之前说的，能参与你们的事业是我的荣幸。

source: Now, let’s move on and discuss when the project is expected to be completed.
translation: 现在继续讨论项目预计何时完工。

source: We are going to maintain the same target of at least a month before next year’s summer term begins.
translation: 目标仍然不变：至少要在明年夏季营期开始前一个月完成。

source: I would like to raise a concern about that, sir.
translation: 关于这一点，我有个顾虑，先生。

source: Just for the renovations alone, I don’t think our current staff will be capable of performing the construction labor in several months’ time.
translation: 单是翻修工程，我认为现有员工就无法在几个月内承担全部施工工作。

source: Hahahaha! Why, I wouldn’t put you in such an impossible situation, Mr. Nomoru!
translation: 哈哈哈哈！我当然不会让你陷入这种不可能完成的处境，Nomoru先生！

source: It’s unreasonable to ask your team of four people to handle all of this.
translation: 要求你们四个人的小团队承担所有工作，显然不合理。

source: On that note, please allow me some time to gather the required manpower to cater for all this work.
translation: 说到这里，请给我一些时间召集足够的人手，以应对所有这些工作。

source: I’ve already got it covered – I signed on with a contractor who will provide us a team of professionals with the best expertise to handle the work.
translation: 我已经安排好了——我与一家承包商签了约，他们会派出专业团队，以最合适的技术能力完成工程。

source: Oh… Isn’t that too much, sir? I mean… you’ve already funded the entire expansion.
translation: 哦……这会不会太破费了，先生？我是说……您已经为整个扩建工程提供了资金。

source: Consider this as part of the sponsorship. All you’ll need to do as the camp president is give me your approval on the upgrade plans we proposed.
translation: 把这也视为赞助的一部分吧。作为营地负责人，你只需要批准我们提出的升级方案。

source: That, and to assign one of your staff to coordinate with whichever representatives I will send to the site on my behalf. Now, isn’t that convenient for both of us?
translation: 此外，再指定一名员工，与我派往现场的代表协调工作。这样对我们双方不是都很方便吗？

source: It is, sir. Thank you very much for your generosity.
translation: 确实如此，先生。非常感谢您的慷慨。

source: When is our official starting date for the project, if I may ask?
translation: 请问项目正式开工的日期是什么时候？

source: I would say as soon as possible since our deadline is tight.
translation: 工期很紧，所以我认为越快越好。

source: As a matter of fact, I can send a team as early as tomorrow to give them ample time to settle in and familiarize with the site, if that’s alright on your end.
translation: 事实上，如果你这边没有问题，我最早明天就能派一支团队过去，让他们有充足时间安顿下来并熟悉现场。

source: Wh-What…? Tomorrow?
translation: 什、什么……？明天？

source: I agree with you, Mr. Clermont. I’ll have my staff prepare for their arrival. We’ll allot some of the vacant cabins for temporary housing throughout the construction.
translation: 我同意，Clermont先生。我会让员工为他们的到来做好准备，并安排一些空置木屋，供施工期间临时住宿。

source: We’ll set a daily schedule and send off teams by their specialty until all the required workforce has been fully mobilized at the camp.
translation: 我们会制定每日计划，按照专业分批派出团队，直到所需人力全部进驻营地。

source: I know this may be a little overwhelming, but I assume it’s not new to you to be handling a large amount of people working on a common goal.
translation: 我知道这可能让人有些应接不暇，不过组织大量人员为共同目标工作，对你来说应该并不陌生。

source: That’s right. I’m confident we can manage.
translation: 没错。我有信心处理好。

source: Lastly, we have to cover the legal side of this project. If we’re aiming to move in tomorrow and start immediately, we’ll require the documentations and permits.
translation: 最后，我们还要处理项目的法律事务。如果计划明天进驻并立即开工，就需要相关文件和许可证。

source: About that, I’ve been working with the local city hall ever since the end of the previous term. The good news is that I was able to secure all the necessary paperwork.
translation: 关于这一点，从上个营期结束起，我就一直在和当地市政厅协调。好消息是，所有必要文件都已经办妥。

source: I will make the needed adjustments based on the updated scope we discussed today, and I’ll head there tomorrow to claim all the permits.
translation: 我会根据今天讨论的新工程范围作出必要调整，并在明天前往市政厅领取全部许可证。

source: Excellent! It really shows how much you have prepared for this, Mr. Nomoru.
translation: 太好了！看得出来你为此做了充分准备，Nomoru先生。

source: It’s honestly the least I could do, sir.
translation: 说实话，这只是我最起码该做的，先生。

source: You can count on my staff and I to do our part throughout this entire project.
translation: 整个项目期间，您可以相信我和我的员工一定会尽好职责。

source: Hahaha, of course. Now, I believe we’ve covered all matters that needed to be discussed today?
translation: 哈哈哈，当然。那么，今天需要讨论的事项应该都已经谈完了吧？

source: Indeed. We won’t take up any more of your time.
translation: 是的。我们就不再占用您的时间了。

source: Alright then, this meeting is adjourned! We’ll see each other next week for another meeting.
translation: 那么，本次会议到此结束！我们下周再开会。

source: Yes, sir. Thank you for today.
translation: 好的，先生。感谢您今天抽出时间。

source: Whew…
So…? How was your first professional meeting?
translation: 那么……？第一次参加正式商务会议感觉怎么样？

source: So…? How was your first professional meeting?{fast}
translation: 那么……？第一次参加正式商务会议感觉怎么样？{fast}

source: It was a little stressful.
translation: 有点紧张。

source: Honestly, it stressed me out a little.
translation: 说实话，我有点紧张。

source: The conversation moved so fast that I didn’t know when I was supposed to talk, or even have time to process the information!
translation: 谈话节奏太快了，我根本不知道该什么时候开口，甚至都来不及消化那些信息！

source: At some point, I felt bad that I wasn’t contributing anything to the discussion.
translation: 有一阵子，我因为没能为讨论作出任何贡献而感到很惭愧。

source: Don’t worry, I wasn’t expecting you to actively participate. I understand that this was something out of your comfort zone.
translation: 别担心，我本来也没指望你积极参与。我知道这超出了你熟悉的范围。

source: Regardless, it’s a good thing to experience.
translation: 无论如何，这都是一次有益的经历。

source: A busy man like Mr. Clermont can only spare us a little time, so it’s important to get straight to the point and accomplish as much as possible in every meeting.
translation: Clermont先生这样的大忙人只能抽出一点时间，所以每次会议都必须开门见山，尽可能处理更多事务。

source: I understand, sir.
translation: 我明白了，先生。

source: It's so different from back at camp.
translation: 这和营地里的会议太不一样了。

source: It was… pretty nerve-racking… It’s so different from the ones we usually have back at camp.
translation: 这场会议……相当令人紧张……和我们平时在营地开的完全不一样。

source: The conversation moved so fast that I didn’t know when I was supposed to talk, or even have time to process the information!
translation: 谈话节奏太快了，我根本不知道该什么时候开口，甚至都来不及消化那些信息！

source: It's a good thing you were there.
translation: 幸好有您在场。

source: It’s a good thing you were there, sir.
translation: 幸好有您在场，先生。

source: Mr. Clermont brought up a lot of things that required decisions on the spot, and you were able to cater to all of them.
translation: Clermont先生提出了很多需要当场决定的事项，而您全都妥善应对了。

source: I could barely keep up with the pace of the discussion. I wish I could've contributed as much as you did!
translation: 我几乎跟不上讨论的节奏。真希望自己也能像您一样作出那么多贡献！

source: You’ll learn with more experience. A busy man like Mr. Clermont can only spare us so much time, so I had to be sure to respect that.
translation: 多积累经验，你就会学会的。Clermont先生这样的大忙人只能抽出这么多时间，所以我必须尊重他的安排。

source: It’s important to get straight to the point and accomplish as much as possible in every meeting.
translation: 每次会议都必须开门见山，尽可能处理更多事务。

source: But honestly, they aren’t that different from our own meetings back at camp.
translation: 不过说实话，这和我们在营地开的会议并没有那么不同。

source: You had everything under control.
translation: 一切都在您的掌控之中。

source: I was really impressed at how well you handled everything, sir!
translation: 先生，您把所有事情都处理得那么好，真的让我非常佩服！

source: Even though the conversation moved quickly, you were able to keep up with every concern Mr. Clermont brought up.
translation: 尽管谈话节奏很快，Clermont先生提出的每项问题，您都能及时跟上。

source: You even made a lot of important decisions on the spot… I’m not sure I could have done that!
translation: 您甚至当场作出了很多重要决定……我不确定自己能不能做到！

source: Heh, you should’ve seen the look on your face the entire meeting, Yoshinori. You looked like a lost kid in a mall.
translation: 呵，Yoshinori，你真该看看自己开会时的表情，简直像个在商场里迷路的孩子。

source: G-Gah…! Was it that bad? I hope Mr. Clermont didn’t notice.
translation: 呃、呃啊……！有那么糟吗？希望Clermont先生没有注意到。

source: It seems like your lucky charm didn’t work one bit. Hahaha!
translation: 看来你的幸运符一点作用都没发挥。哈哈哈！

source: *sigh* I don’t know how you do it, sir.
translation: *叹气* 真不知道您是怎么做到的，先生。

source: If you do a certain thing over and over, you’ll realize it’s not as complicated as you think.
translation: 一件事反复做得多了，你就会发现它并没有想象中那么复杂。

source: But I have to admit, it was nice to have your company here for once.
translation: 不过我得承认，偶尔有你陪我来这里，感觉很不错。

source: In a way, it made me more confident having you around for the meeting.
translation: 某种意义上，有你陪着参加会议，让我也更有信心。

source: Also, watching you sweat from nervousness was rather entertaining.
translation: 而且，看你紧张得直冒汗，也相当有趣。

source: Now I’m not sure if you should let me tag along next time….
translation: 现在我都不确定下次您还该不该带我来了……

source: {i}Sir Goro continued to tease and chat with me on the car ride back… It was actually really fun to see him loosened up like that.{/i}
translation: {i}回程的车上，Goro先生继续打趣我、和我聊天……看到他这样放松下来，其实真的很有趣。{/i}

source: {i}Time flew by, and before I knew it, we were back at Camp Buddy.{/i}
translation: {i}时间飞逝，不知不觉间，我们已经回到了 Camp Buddy。{/i}

source: {i}Sir Goro immediately called a meeting with the other scoutmasters to prepare for the workers’ arrival tomorrow.{/i}
translation: {i}Goro先生立刻召集其他童军团长开会，为工人们明天的到来作准备。{/i}

source: So that wraps up everything. I’ve given you the in-depth details of the renovations that Mr. Clermont gave me so that we’re all equally clear.
translation: 以上就是全部内容。我已经把Clermont先生提供的翻修细节都详细说明了，确保大家理解一致。

source: Woah, this is a really huge deal, Gramps… Looking at everything, this is gonna cost a fortune!
translation: 哇，这可真是个大工程，Gramps……看这些项目，肯定得花上一大笔钱！

source: Well, Dad said that everything in the construction will be covered by the sponsorship.
translation: 爸爸说了，所有施工费用都会由赞助承担。

source: That’s right. The only things that are not covered are the miscellaneous stuff that we need. But all of that should be handled by the fundraising that we did last year.
translation: 没错。没有涵盖的只有我们需要的一些杂项物资，不过去年筹集的资金应该足以负担。

source: Anyway, is everyone clear on the tasks I’ve given you?
translation: 总之，我分配的任务大家都清楚了吗？

source: Yes! I’ll be coordinating with the contractors tomorrow to tour them around the camp and provide them accommodations!
translation: 清楚！明天我会与承包商协调，带他们参观营地并安排住宿！

source: Yep, and I’ll be making sure the workers are fed and keeping up the regular maintenance.
translation: 没错，我会负责工人们的饮食，同时继续做好日常维护。

source: As for you, Yoshinori. I will leave you in charge of overseeing the schedule we have planned for this week while I take care of the remaining paperwork.
translation: 至于你，Yoshinori，我处理剩余文件期间，本周计划的监督工作就交给你负责。

source: Yes, sir! You can count on me!
translation: 是，先生！交给我吧！

source: Great! If we’re all clear, then this meeting is adjourned.
translation: 很好！既然大家都清楚了，本次会议到此结束。

source: Kyaa~ I’m really excited! If everything goes well, I’m sure it’ll be Camp Buddy’s peak!
translation: 呀～我太兴奋了！如果一切顺利，Camp Buddy 肯定会迎来巅峰！

source: Just imagine all of the activities I’ll be able to do now that we have a bigger budget, hehehe…
translation: 想想预算增加后，我能举办多少活动吧，嘿嘿嘿……

source: Hehe, knowing you, you’d probably throw another costume party.
translation: 呵呵，以我对你的了解，你大概又会办一场化装派对。

source: That was one of the best ideas I had last summer! I have plenty of other “sexier” ideas for everyone to enjoy~! Hehehe…
translation: 那可是我去年夏天想出的最佳点子之一！我还有很多更“性感”的主意，可以让大家尽情享受～！嘿嘿嘿……

source: *sigh* You know we’re supposed to use the budget for improvements, Yuri…
translation: *叹气* Yuri，你知道预算应该用于改善营地……

source: *ahem* Yoshinori’s right. Let’s not go overboard and stick to our plans.
translation: *清嗓子* Yoshinori说得对。不要做得太过火，还是按计划来。

source: I know, I know! Now, why don’t you two get out of your fancy suits and take the rest of the night off?
translation: 知道啦，知道啦！现在你们两个何不换下漂亮的西装，今晚剩下的时间好好休息？

source: Hold on, they do look sleek and stylish in those outfits! How about we celebrate first?
translation: 等等，他们穿这身真的又利落又帅气！不如先庆祝一下？

source: I have a huge roasted chicken sitting in the oven, and I’m sure it would go well with some champagne!
translation: 烤箱里正烤着一只大鸡，我敢说配香槟一定很棒！

source: We might not get a chance for something like this again with how busy we’ll get, after all!
translation: 毕竟接下来会忙成那样，以后可能再也找不到这样的机会了！

source: What?! You’re gonna drink again?! No way! Especially when we’re expecting new people tomorrow!
translation: 什么？！你们又要喝酒？！绝对不行！尤其明天还有新人要来！

source: The last thing I want is you guys being groggy and hungover as our first impression!
translation: 我最不想看到的，就是你们宿醉后昏昏沉沉地给人留下第一印象！

source: *sigh* As much as I would love a drink tonight to relax… Yuri has a point.
translation: *叹气* 虽然我今晚很想喝一杯放松……但Yuri说得有道理。

source: We can celebrate with the roasted chicken, but let’s lay off on the alcohol for now, alright?!
translation: 我们可以吃烤鸡庆祝，但现在先别喝酒，好吗？！

source: Alright, alright. No drinks for tonight! Right, Yoshi and Gramps? *wink wink*
translation: 好吧，好吧。今晚不喝酒！对吧，Yoshi、Gramps？*眨眼*

source: Hey, I saw that!!
translation: 喂，我看见了！！

source: UGH! FINALLY, you old geezers are here! We’ve been waiting here all day!
translation: 呃啊！你们这些老家伙终于来了！我们都在这里等一整天了！

source: Yoichi, it’s only been ten minutes.
translation: Yoichi，才过了十分钟。

source: Gah! I don’t care! Time moves slower when I’m hungry!
translation: 啊！我不管！肚子饿的时候，时间就是过得更慢！

source: We’re sorry about that! We just had a meeting to take care of!
translation: 让你们久等了！我们刚才有个会议要处理！

source: Tch. You guys keep acting so busy even when there’s nobody here.
translation: 啧。明明这里一个人都没有，你们却还是整天忙个不停。

source: And I bet you forgot about us again! I haven’t seen any of you since yesterday!
translation: 我敢说你们又把我们忘了！从昨天起我就一个人都没见到！

source: Ugh… He’s always like this when it’s his feeding time… I told him we could just heat up whatever’s in the fridge.
translation: 唉……每到吃饭时间他就这样……我都说了，冰箱里有什么热一下就行。

source: No way I’m eating leftovers again! Besides, I can smell they’re hiding the goods here! This nose doesn’t lie!
translation: 我才不要再吃剩饭！而且我闻得出来，他们把好东西藏在这里！我的鼻子绝不会骗人！

source: Well, today’s your lucky day, Yoichi~! Aiden cooked up something special for dinner!
translation: 那么，今天算你走运，Yoichi～！Aiden为晚餐做了特别料理！

source: Haha! I better get that ready to serve before Yoichi loses it! Be right back!
translation: 哈哈！最好赶在Yoichi失控前把菜端上来！马上回来！

source: Soooo… what’s up with the suits? It’s been a long time since I’ve seen you guys wear something so formal.
translation: 所以说……这身西装是怎么回事？很久没见你们穿得这么正式了。

source: Ah, we had a meeting with Mr. Clermont earlier today.
translation: 啊，我们今天早些时候和Clermont先生开了个会。

source: Why’d you dress like pimps for a boring meeting?
translation: 参加个无聊的会议，干吗穿得像皮条客一样？

source: *sigh* To think I spent so much on this outfit just to look like that…
translation: *叹气* 没想到我花这么多钱买的衣服，穿起来竟然像那样……

source: Pimps have a lot of money too, you know.
translation: 你也知道，皮条客同样很有钱。

source: Yoichi! There’s no way either of us, especially Sir Goro, would do something like that!
translation: Yoichi！我们两个都不可能做那种事，尤其是Goro先生！

source: Whatever you say, simp.
translation: 随你怎么说吧，舔狗。

source: What was the meeting about anyway? It must’ve been super important for you guys to dress up like that.
translation: 话说会议到底谈了什么？能让你们穿成这样，肯定非常重要。

source: It was a huge deal, actually… Keitaro’s book did so well on the market that Mr. Clermont offered an even bigger budget to improve the camp.
translation: 其实确实是件大事……Keitaro的书在市场上表现很好，所以Clermont先生提供了更多预算来改善营地。

source: With the sponsorship going into effect, things are going to be busy from now on, and I expect you both to do your best to help out as much as you can.
translation: 赞助正式生效后，从现在起会非常忙碌。我希望你们两个都尽最大努力，能帮多少就帮多少。

source: Not sure about Yoichi here, but I’ve been waiting for something to work on! Time here has been really slow during the off-season, after all.
translation: Yoichi怎么样我不知道，但我一直等着有事可做！毕竟休营期的日子实在过得太慢了。

source: Hey, it’s better than dying of boredom. These muscles could use some working out anyways.
translation: 嘿，总比无聊死好。反正这些肌肉也该活动活动了。

source: Now that’s the spirit! I hope you’ll keep that positive attitude for when all the new workers arrive tomorrow and start working!
translation: 这才对嘛！希望明天新工人全部到来并开工后，你还能保持这种积极态度！

source: Oh, great… New people.
translation: 哦，太好了……又有新人。

source: Please at least try and get along with them, Yoichi.
translation: 至少试着和他们好好相处吧，Yoichi。

source: Well, I guess I could use some new faces around here. I’m tired of seeing Dynamite and hearing him nag every day.
translation: 好吧，这里确实该来点新面孔了。我已经受够每天看着“Dynamite”那张脸、听他唠叨。

source: You’re one to talk! Being stuck here with you is so exhausting – it made me miss having Eduard and Lee around instead.
translation: 你还有脸说！和你一起困在这里累死人了——害我反而开始想念Eduard和Lee在身边的日子。

source: Same goes for you! I’d rather hang out with Mr. Perfect or Twinkerbell, or even that annoying Torch-head!
translation: 你也一样！我宁愿和“Mr. Perfect”或“Twinkerbell”待在一起，甚至那个烦人的“Torch-head”都行！

source: Aww~ look at you guys, missing your friends! That’s really cute! Have you been keeping in touch at least?
translation: 哎呀～瞧你们两个，都开始想念朋友了！真可爱！你们至少还有保持联系吧？

source: Yeah, we have! Even though everyone has started getting busy with their own things, we still find time to catch up with each other.
translation: 有啊！虽然大家都开始忙自己的事情，我们还是会找时间互相聊聊近况。

source: Yeah, I guess that time we had a group call was kinda fun. Better than hearing Dynamite’s annoying voice all the time.
translation: 是啊，那次群组通话还算有点意思。总比一直听“Dynamite”烦人的声音好。

source: Ugh…
Well, aren’t you two getting along just nicely~
translation: 哎呀，你们两个相处得不是挺好嘛～

source: Sorry it took so long! I had to whip up some mashed potatoes too!
translation: 抱歉花了这么久！我还得做些土豆泥！

source: UGH, GREAT!!! I’m starving!!
translation: 呃啊，太好了！！！我快饿死了！！

source: H-Hey! Stop hogging all the food! Save the thigh part of the chicken for me!
translation: 喂、喂！别一个人霸占所有食物！给我留只鸡腿！

source: You snooze, you lose!
translation: 谁慢谁就没得吃！

source: Now, now, there’s plenty for everybody!
translation: 好了，好了，每个人都有份！

source: I’ll go set the table!
translation: 我去摆餐桌！

source: Hehe… I told you, you’re already doing a good job. Just look how much those two have grown.
translation: 呵呵……我说过了，你已经做得很好。看看那两个孩子成长了多少。

source: You’re right, sir… I couldn’t be prouder.
translation: 您说得对，先生……我为他们感到无比骄傲。

source: Why don’t we join them? We had a long day, and I think we’ve earned a good meal.
translation: 我们也过去吧？忙了一整天，我想我们值得好好吃上一顿。

source: R-Right!
translation: 好、好的！

source: {i}After a busy day handling all the camp’s business with Sir Goro, we made sure to enjoy our time together, just the six of us. {/i}
translation: {i}和Goro先生忙碌一整天、处理完营地的各项事务后，我们六个人一起享受了难得的相聚时光。{/i}

source: {i}Knowing how much change was coming starting tomorrow, it makes me feel thankful for the simple times like this I get to spend with everyone.{/i}
translation: {i}想到明天开始会迎来那么多变化，我更加珍惜像这样与大家共度的简单时光。{/i}
